text: The owned alarm test scrolls menus and text fields to block end. Its text helper becomes async and yields one tick after typing; callers await event and task entries in order before comparing saved preferences. Accepted browser_alarms.js retains this sequence and menu popup shown/hidden waits. A tick is not an explicit preference-write or visibility condition, and the local scroll change does not alter the production pane helper. No headless or UI test ran.
title: Alarm preference text entry yields before callers check the saved values
